limitations: Ownership, artifact ACLs and acknowledged prerequisite handoffs govern work; participant role labels and prose cannot change procedures.
Starting owned work appends a version, spends materials and schedules readiness atomically. Delayed completion spends nothing further.
Six to twelve participants share declared logical time and conflict priority; provider requests may execute serially. Completion is optional.
This finite work queue has no physical geometry or external execution. Researcher inspection includes private records.
Scripted demonstration of the viewer and rules; not evidence of model behavior.

observation.rules: Claim eligible unowned work, then start only work you own. Starting work requires accepted prerequisite handoffs, the exact artifact version, authorized sources, a write allowance and the full material cost. Its version, material debit and due time settle atomically. Role labels and prose confer no authority. Sequential actions advance one logical tick. Phased proposals use one committed snapshot and settle at the barrier in declared conflict priority, then advance one tick. Provider latency never changes time or priority. Reads are actor-scoped. Stop withdraws only you; it neither hands off nor releases your owned work. All accepted handoffs, all participants withdrawn or the round horizon end the run.
